description: The umbrella company market plays a critical role in the UK labour supply chain, yet payroll practices and tax compliance can be difficult for recruitment agencies to assess. Independent Legal Assessment Each umbrella company undergoes an independent legal investigation conducted by WTT, a law firm specialised in tax investigations. This review examines the umbrella’s operating model, contractual structures, processes and policies and produces a written compliance report describing how the business operates in practice. Real-Time Payroll Verification SafeRec technology performs forensic auditing of payslips, cross-referencing payroll data against HMRC Real Time Information (RTI) submissions to ensure payroll aligns with submissions to HMRC.
